mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NC.user_token (token, username, expire_at) VALUES (#{token}, #{username}, #{expireAt})
mapper.select: SELECT username FROM NC.user_token WHERE token = #{token} AND expire_at > NOW() LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE NC.user_token SET expire_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{seconds} SECOND) WHERE token = #{token} AND expire_at > NOW()
